# Railway

Railway is a deployment platform for building and shipping applications with instant deployments, automatic scaling, and managed infrastructure.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/railway/.

## Actions

- **Create Plugin**: Creates a new plugin in Railway for the specified project.
- **Delete Variable**: Delete a Railway environment variable.
- **Delete Volume**: Permanently delete a persistent volume and all its associated data from Railway.
- **Delete workspace**: Delete a Railway workspace and all data associated with it.
- **Disconnect Discord account**: Disconnects the authenticated user's Railway account from Discord.
- **Get Deployment Logs** (read-only): Retrieve runtime logs for a deployment.
- **Get Environment** (read-only): Get details of a specific Railway environment by its ID, including service instances and deployment information.
- **Get GitHub PR Info** (read-only): Get information for a GitHub pull request associated with a Railway service.
- **Get User Kickback Earnings** (read-only): Get the total kickback earnings for the authenticated Railway user.
- **List API Tokens** (read-only): Retrieve all API tokens for the authenticated user from Railway.
- **List Environment Patches** (read-only): Retrieve all patches for a Railway environment using the GraphQL API.
- **List GitHub Repos** (read-only): Retrieve a list of GitHub repositories that Railway has access to.
- **List GitHub Writable Scopes** (read-only): Retrieve the list of GitHub scopes the user has installed the installation to.
- **List Integration Auths** (read-only): Retrieve all integration auths for the authenticated user from Railway.
- **List Notification Deliveries** (read-only): Retrieve notification deliveries for the authenticated user.
- **List Railway Trusted Domains** (read-only): Fetch all trusted domains for the authenticated Railway workspace.
- **Update Project**: Update project settings and configuration on Railway.
- **Update Service Instance**: Update build/deploy settings for a service in a specific environment on Railway.
